# shared/sbom fixtures

Hand-written minimal documents, one per behaviour the parser claims. Each is
small enough to read in full, because a golden test whose fixture nobody reads
pins whatever the code happened to do on the day it was written.

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `cyclonedx-1.5.json` | The 1.5 floor of the supported range. purl case folding, a CPE 2.2 URI on a component, an SPDX licence id, a licence expression, `group` as the vendor fallback, `scope`, a dependency graph rooted at `metadata.component`. |
| `cyclonedx-1.6.json` | Unknown top-level and component fields ignored; `publisher` beating `group`; qualifier sorting in a purl; a licence with only a free-text `name`; an unversioned component; a component type outside the enum; a dangling dependency edge. |
| `cyclonedx-nested.json` | Nested `components` flattened three levels deep with `Parent` recorded at each level. |
| `cyclonedx-malformed.json` | Every malformed shape at once — components that are strings, numbers and nulls; a nameless component; a wrong-typed `version`; an unparseable purl and CPE; `licenses` that is not an array; dependency entries with no `ref` and a non-array `dependsOn`. Nothing here may fail the document. |
| `cyclonedx-pem.json` | PEM private-key blocks in carried fields (`name`, `publisher`, `purl`) and in a dropped one (`description`). The redaction mutation test deletes `redactStrings` and this fixture is what goes red. A `CERTIFICATE` block is present too — it is posture and must survive. |
| `spdx-2.3.json` | `documentDescribes` and a DESCRIBES relationship; `externalRefs` for purl, `cpe23Type` and `cpe22Type`; `supplier` and `originator` prefixes; `NOASSERTION` and `NONE` licences; an unmapped `primaryPackagePurpose`; `files[]`; DEPENDS_ON, CONTAINS, a dangling edge and two unmapped relationship types. |
| `spdx-2.2.json` | The 2.2 floor: the `PACKAGE-MANAGER` hyphen spelling of the external-ref category, and `DESCRIBED_BY` as the reverse of DESCRIBES. |
| `vista-cbom-1.7.json` | **Our own output.** Generated by `services/cbom-service/internal/formatters.CycloneDXFormatter.FormatCBOMAsJSON` and checked in verbatim — `shared` may not import `cbom-service`, so it cannot be built at test time. It proves the CBOM path's documents parse here: the `library` component becomes a product, the two `cryptographic-asset` components are skipped with a counted warning rather than an error, and the `provides` dependency entry contributes no edge. Regenerate it by running that formatter if the emitted shape ever changes. |

The over-cap document is generated inside the test rather than committed: a
32 MiB fixture in git to prove a size check works is a bad trade.
